gloss: fun; enjoyment; how enjoyable something is

definitions.gloss: fun; enjoyment; the pleasure of doing something
definitions.explanation: The quality of being enjoyable, treated as a thing that can be known, conveyed, or tasted. Formed from {楽|たの}しい plus the noun-making suffix さ, so it names the degree of enjoyment rather than a particular occasion of it.

examples.english: I came to know the pleasure of travel.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{楽|たの}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{出会|であ}える→出会う：02298_deau⟧ことだ。
examples.english: What is enjoyable about this job is getting to meet people.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもたち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧{楽|たの}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}えたい→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っている→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I want to convey to children how enjoyable reading is.

notes:
The さ form of ⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧. Adding さ to an i-adjective stem turns it into a noun naming the quality itself: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ → ⟦{高|たか}さ→高さ：05327_takasa⟧ (height), ⟦{面白|おもしろ}い→面白い：00589_omoshiroi⟧ → {面白|おもしろ}さ (interest).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽|たの}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to discover how enjoyable something is
- {楽|たの}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧: to convey the fun of something
- {楽|たの}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{味|あじ}わう→味わう：04405_ajiwau⟧: to savor the enjoyment
- {楽|たの}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伝|つた}わって→伝わる：01961_tsutawaru⟧くる: the fun comes across

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧: something to look forward to — a pleasure or treat that lies ahead, as in ⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ; {楽|たの}しさ is the enjoyable quality of something already experienced
- ⟦{喜|よろこ}び→喜び：03672_yorokobi⟧: joy — a felt emotion, often at a specific event, rather than a quality of an activity
